summary: C6-free and its combination with C6-covered are sound modulo the explicitly unproved A4 and imported local/external results. This establishes only conditional complete six-hole coverage, not A4 or full P6.
model_override: User-requested GPT-6.1-sol high overrides proof-checker default Astra ultra.

input_scope.reused_dependencies: K4, N10, N14, A4, Z18, five-direction theorem and C6-covered from this same independent reviewer preceding audits; application hypotheses checked anew. Existing external source chains not recursively certified. paper.txt usage is previously read Theorem8 and C1-C3; TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md usage is N14 statement/proof only.
input_scope.excluded: No geometry enumeration or matching/path search used. No old review, proof, census, or ledger edits.

micro_obligations.note: Short M with six holes has three even and three odd holes. Translation can normalize u even, and the other free opposite-parity endpoint v is one of the three odd holes.
Adding a short edge between non-root holes keeps u free, yields a four-hole supermatching for Z18, and may cover v legally because Z18 allows either free or covered targets.
Distinct even holes z,q have a differing coordinate. After relabeling there is exactly one non-root even hole z in A and q in B; A contains one, two, or three original odd holes including v.
If c=0, all M edges avoid coordinate i. The five-direction theorem applies to Q6 with free u and opposite-parity v; all C1-C3 obstacles require u covered and hence fail.

NC applies only to a complete-graph matching with two opposite-parity holes. A short-neighbor target of one hole has parity of the other; N10 gives a full 32-vertex path and the short endpoint edge closes it without duplicating a path edge.

Every D is supported on currently M_A-free ports and optional original hole z or w. It avoids chosen path endpoints u,v or a,v. Matching deletion cannot isolate an internal path vertex, so all resulting segments are nontrivial.

When u lies in A, each indicated D is nonempty and included in P_A. Deleting it separates u and v. Appending mutually different fresh B endpoints by real cross-edges and the chosen bridge neither joins old A components nor creates a cycle.

The resulting terminal components and R-partition cover A vertices exactly once. Distinct terminal B endpoints are omitted from R; all other ports and the bridge endpoint are in R. This proves connectivity after the local B path is attached, beyond mere degree counts.

If y is internally covered in B and also covered by R, it is the sole overlap. k=M_B(y) is outside ports, holes and terminal endpoints; d=R(y) is a nonterminal cross-port. Replacing yk,yd by kd gives a legal complete-graph matching.

The replacement kd is always distinct from and endpoint-disjoint from the temporary terminal-joining auxiliary edge. It survives deletion of that edge and expands to ky followed by the y-d transfer segment, restoring y once and all original matching edges.
A holes u,z even and v,w odd give even c. Removing the c=0 case yields c>=2. D pairs X_A, hence is nonempty and disjoint from u,v. M_A+D has balanced four holes for K4 u-v.

R covers X_B minus distinct r,s. M_B+R has holes q,t,r,s. Add rs, leaving exactly opposite-parity holes q,t, apply NC, delete rs, expand R and attach terminal paths. No parity assumption on r,s is used.
A holes z even and v,w odd force excess one even port, hence odd c>=1 and an even a. D pairs X_A minus a and may be empty; four holes z,a,v,w are balanced for K4 a-v.
With one terminal r-v, R covers X_B minus r. B matching M_B+R has holes u,q,t,r. Add ur, apply NC to remaining q,t, delete ur and attach terminal path at r.
For y=z xor e_i, y is odd and differs from w,t by nonadjacency preprocessing and from u,q by parity. Its unique crossing neighbor z is free, so y is internally M_B-covered and is not a port.
A holes u,z even and v odd force odd c>=1. D pairs X_A plus z, is nonempty and avoids u,v. M_A+D has precisely holes u,v, and N10 root u, target v applies.
If y is terminal and other terminal b is a port, R covers X_B minus b and M_B+R has holes q,w,t,b. k=L_B(y)=M_B(y), since R omits y. b differs from k,y,q,w,t because b is a cross-port.
Replace yk by kb: the free hole b is filled and y is freed, irrespective of parity(b). The four holes become exactly even q and odd w,t,y. A4 omitting y gives a 31-cycle containing kb.

Delete kb and append original edge ky at k, obtaining a full B b-y Hamilton path containing every L_B edge. No K4 is invoked in this possibly unbalanced four-hole case. Expansion and orientation attach the two terminal paths.

If y is in R, unique-overlap repair has exactly six holes q,w,t,r,s,y. Add rs, leaving q even and w,t,y odd; A4 omits y. Delete rs, expand kd to restore y, then expand all other R and attach terminals.
A holes z even,v odd force equal port parity counts. After c=0 is excluded, c>=2 and an even a exists. D pairs (X_A minus a) plus z and avoids a,v. Its union with M_A has holes a,v; N10 yields a-v.
If r=y, R covers all X_B and M_B+R has balanced four holes u,q,w,t. K4 applies from free even u to internally covered odd y; expand and append terminal y-v.
If r is a port, unique-overlap repair has six holes u,q,w,t,r,y. Add ur to leave q even and w,t,y odd. A4 omits y; delete ur, expand kd restoring y, and append terminal path at r.

Choose among mirrors of w,t an internally M_B-covered even y. Neither equals q by preprocessing; at most one can equal root u if u is in B. The selected nonhole candidate has a free cross-neighbor, hence cannot be a port.

With u in B, A holes z even and v,w,t odd force excess two even ports, hence c even>=2 and even a. D pairs (X_A minus a) plus w, yielding balanced holes a,z,v,t; K4 a-v applies and D avoids endpoints.
If r=y, M_B+R holes are same-even u,q. N10 root u to even covered y is valid because parity(y)=parity(q). No false opposite-parity-root requirement is imposed on N10.
If r is a port, repair holes are u,q,r,y. Add ur to leave same-even q,y. N14 omits y; delete ur and expand kd to restore y. Parity(r) need not be fixed.
With u in A, A holes u,z even and v,w,t odd force odd c>=1. D on X_A plus w is nonempty and avoids u,v, giving balanced holes u,z,v,t for K4 u-v and distinct terminal endpoints r,s.
If y is terminal, other terminal b is a port. M_B+R holes are q,b; N10 root b and target even y requires only parity(y)=parity(q), not any parity restriction on b. Expand R and attach terminals.
If y is in R, repair holes are q,y,r,s. Add rs to leave same-even q,y; N14 omits y. Delete rs, expand kd restoring y, and attach terminal paths. All auxiliary edges are deleted or expanded.

All three possible counts of A odd holes and both possible root sides are covered, with every bridge endpoint either terminal or in R. D never contains free v, so the covered-target isolated-v boundary does not occur.

Free proof uses A4->K4, N10, N14, NC, Z18 and five-direction theorem, not C6-covered. Only after proving C6-free is it combined with previously checked C6-covered to obtain A4=>all six-hole endpoints; no circular use of this conclusion occurs.

dependency_dag: C6-free+C6-covered -> A4-conditional complete six-hole endpoint conclusion

cases_checked: Preprocessing edge can cover free target v: legal for Z18
D empty permitted only root-in-B constructions
u/v accidentally same component after D deletion: prevented by nonempty D
3a terminal y with arbitrary-parity other terminal b
k coincides with a port/hole/terminal: excluded by internal coverage
N10 target same parity as q while root b parity arbitrary
NC used only on q/t opposite-parity holes
counterexample_pass.evidence: Explicit hole-set, parity-balance, matching and forest arguments; no empirical path enumeration.

open_obligations.note: Not used as a proved result here.
Conditional six-hole endpoint coverage is complete, but A4 and general eight-or-more-hole cases remain open.

scope_update: Six-hole free targets now also reduce to A4. The two prior reports retain their original submission scope and are unchanged; their then-open free-target note is superseded only by this new conditional reduction.
